issues.description: The Bitmap24 constructor parameter types are inconsistent across artifacts: the template repository's header declares Bitmap24(long i_width, long i_height) while the corresponding implementation defines Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height). The solution repository uses Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) in the header. This mismatch (long vs int) creates a conceptual/implementation mapping problem for students — they may be unable to reliably locate or use the constructor declared in the header, and it may lead to compilation/link confusion when comparing template and solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent across header and implementation and across template/solution. Update the template header to declare Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height) to match the implementation (or change the implementation to use long if intended). Ensure both template and solution use the same parameter types so students can unambiguously map the requirement to the implementation.
